summary: Frontend-only test of new batch (Olympe/olympia theme, Aurum seal, Elysium sound pack, no creation autoplay, per-theme card effects). All requested checks PASSED. No pageerrors / console errors on Home, /parametres, /oeuvre/:id (only browser AudioContext-before-gesture warnings).

ui_bugs.component: Cosmic Bunny bubble (cb-bubble) on Detail page
ui_bugs.issue: At 1100x800 the auto-opened Cosmic Bunny tip bubble sits on top of the Ambiance button (elementFromPoint at detail-ambient center = cb-bubble) and the share/action row; user must close the bubble before clicking Ambiance. Pre-existing, not part of this batch.

design_issues.screen: Home poster captions on light themes (olympia, bunny)
issues: The small category label .pcap .pcat ('FILMS') is very faint (silver on #eef0f3 for olympia, pale pink on bunny bg) – low contrast. Titles .ct are fine (rgb(36,39,45) olympia, rgb(74,63,69) bunny).

action_items: Optional: darken .pcat color for olympia/bunny light themes
Optional: avoid Cosmic Bunny bubble covering Detail action buttons (detail-ambient) on ~1100px viewports
critical_code_review_comments: Detail.js: useEffect(() => () => stopAmbient(), [item?.id]) captures stopAmbient from the render when item.id changed; works now since stopAmbient only reads refs, but keep it ref-based to avoid stale closures.

Headless Chromium crashes ('Target crashed') after ~4-5 consecutive in-page theme switches on Home – could hint at heavy per-theme background/animation memory; worth checking CosmicBackground cleanup on theme change.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use workaround from iteration_25: unregister SW, route service-worker.js abort, set localStorage sx_intro_off=1, sx_tour_done=1, sessionStorage sx_entered=1, sx_theme=<key>, ONE goto per run.
